answers.expected_answer: More total warriors plus buildings than each other player; ordinary ties mean no ruler. Eyrie win a tie for most if they have at least one Eyrie piece there. Tokens and pawns do not contribute; Vagabond cannot rule or prevent rule.

Move more than zero warriors/pawns along one linking path to an adjacent clearing; rule origin or destination or both. Same pieces can move repeatedly. Rivers are not paths unless explicitly treated as such.

Defender may ambush matching clearing; attacker may foil with matching ambush. Unfoiled ambush deals two immediate hits; discard defender ambush, end battle if no attacking warriors/pawns remain. Before-roll effects, roll high attacker/low defender, rolled hits capped by own warriors, after-roll effects, count hits including uncapped extra hits and defenseless extra attacker hit if no defending warriors, then deal hits. Each side chooses own removals, warriors first. Whoever removes enemy building/token scores one, including defender.

Activate crafting pieces matching every crafting icon; each piece may normally activate only once per turn. A crafting piece's suit is its clearing's suit, and the card's own suit is not its crafting cost. An item must be available in the map supply or that card cannot be crafted. Resolve an immediate effect and discard the card; a persistent effect stays in the play area, and an identical persistent effect already there prevents crafting another. For Vagabond crafting, exhaust one face-up, undamaged hammer per crafting icon; the pawn may be activated repeatedly, but its clearing must match every crafting icon. Reusing the pawn does not waive the hammer payment for each icon.

During own Daylight at least 10 VP, put card in play area, remove score marker, no longer score VP. Mouse/rabbit/fox win ruling three matching clearings at start of own Birdsong; bird wins ruling two opposite corner clearings then. Activated card cannot be removed or replaced.

It becomes available near map instead of discard pile. During Daylight spend matching card to take available card into hand. Available bird dominance cannot be treated as non-bird, so requires bird payment.

Remove all four dominance cards; each player draws three cards. Four ruins cover the R slots. The map item supply is 2 boots, 2 bags, 1 crossbow, 1 hammer, 2 swords, 2 tea, 2 coins. Factions set up in letter order: Marquise, Eyrie, Alliance, Vagabond. If Vagabond is present, during its faction setup take the four ruins and the R-marked bag, boot, hammer and sword; put one item beneath each ruin, shuffle the ruin/item stacks as instructed, then return each stack to an empty R ruin slot. Without Vagabond, no hidden ruin items are populated.

Only Marquise may place pieces in keep clearing; others may move into it. Whenever any number of Marquise warriors removed from a clearing, may spend matching card to place those warriors at keep instead of supply. Keep cannot be placed again once removed; no hospital destination without keep.

Craft using workshops first; then up to three actions plus one per bird card spent outside actions. March up to two moves; Recruit once per turn places one warrior per recruiter. Overwork spends card matching sawmill clearing to place one wood there.

Choose ruled clearing with open slot and leftmost building of desired type; pay displayed cost with wood from target or ruled clearings connected through ruled clearings; remove wood, place building and score uncovered space.

Emergency Orders draw one if hand empty; add one or two hand cards to any Decree columns, at most one added bird; if no roosts place roost and three warriors in clearing with fewest warriors where all can be placed.

Craft first; resolve all cards Recruit,Move,Battle,Build in that column order, cards in any order within column. Recruit places one warrior at one chosen roost in a matching clearing (Charismatic must place two instead); Move from matching clearing with at least one warrior; Battle in matching clearing; Build in matching ruled clearing without roost and open slot. Bird wild. Inability fully resolve immediately causes turmoil.

Lose one VP per bird card including Loyal Viziers; discard Decree except Viziers; flip current leader face down, choose face-up new leader, retuck Viziers as listed. If none face up flip all face up. End Daylight, proceed Evening including roost scoring and draw/discard. No removal of map warriors/buildings.

Another player removing sympathy or moving any warriors into sympathetic clearing owes one matching hand card including bird to supporters. Merely battling without removing sympathy is not trigger. If none matching show hand to Alliance; Alliance draws deck card to supporters. No bases caps stack at five; incoming overflow discarded.

Birdsong Revolt before Spread, each any number. Revolt: sympathetic clearing without base whose matching base is on board, pay two matching supporters, remove all enemy pieces, place matching base, warriors equal matching sympathetic clearings, one officer, score removed enemy buildings/tokens. Spread: unsympathetic adjacent to sympathy or any clearing if none; pay shown matching supporters plus one if at least three warriors of one other player; place sympathy and score uncovered points.

Train in Daylight spending hand card matching clearing with base to place supply warrior as officer. Evening has up to number-of-officers military actions; Organize removes own warrior from unsympathetic clearing to place sympathy and score uncovered points. Losing base discards all supporters matching its clearing including birds, removes half officers rounded up; if no bases remain discard supporters down to five.

Refresh two exhausted items per tea already face up on track, then three more; newly refreshed tea does not boost that step. Slip optionally adjacent clearing/forest free boots even hostile, ignoring restrictions on moving out. Normal Move costs boot plus extra boot if hostile warriors at destination; cannot enter forest, may leave to adjacent clearing, rule ignored. Forest Rest repairs all damaged items and flips them face up; still draw one plus face-up coins on track then discard to five.

Explore exhaust torch for item beneath ruin in clearing; take face up, score one VP if item taken, remove ruin after last item. Quest matches clearing suit, exhaust two listed items, complete quest, choose VP equal matching completed quests including this or draw two; replace quest. Repair exhaust hammer to move damaged item to satchel keeping its face; face-up tea/coins/bags move to matching track if able.

Removing any one non-hostile faction warrior makes Hostile. Infamy one extra VP per hostile piece removed in battle during own turn except warrior causing hostility; no Infamy for Strike. Aid cannot undo hostility but can take crafted item. Strike exhaust crossbow, removes enemy warrior, or other faction piece if that enemy has no warriors there.

Vagabond cannot use normal dominance win. With four or more players during own Daylight at least 10 VP activates dominance to coalition with lowest VP other player not already in coalition, choose tied lowest. Place score marker on partner board, stop scoring; partner win means Vagabond also wins. Hostile partner relationship becomes Indifferent.
Card beats Law; Law beats Learning to Play. Follow both general and faction when possible, otherwise faction wins. Cannot is absolute unless explicitly overridden.

Current turn player chooses unclear simultaneous order/decision maker. Cannot interrupt action including compound March unless effect explicitly permits interruption; no other action or bird expenditure between its moves.
Start happens before all other phase effects; end after other phase effects but before next phase. Once last turn step begins no actions except explicitly end-of-Evening or end-of-turn actions.

Hand counts public, contents cannot be shown/revealed unless instructed. Face-up piles inspectable/searchable, shared deck not. Agreements non-binding, card giving only when instructed, actions never require consent.

Immediately shuffle discard into new deck. Bird can match non-bird including multiple matching-card costs; forced non-bird give/discard must include birds. Non-bird cannot substitute for explicit bird.
No proxies; pieces finite. Must place maximum possible, not choose fewer. Costs/prerequisites not waived; required Decree action still must fully complete or turmoil.

Place from supply or leftmost prompted tracked piece. Remove to supply or rightmost empty track space; otherwise permanently, items permanently. Remove all simultaneous pieces before triggering removal effects.
Resolve as if affected player chose it, with their abilities/restrictions; forced battling player makes all battle decisions.
Replacement requires ability both to remove old and place new; enemy cannot place at keep so replacement fails. Swap ignores move/place restrictions including keep.
Tied player closest clockwise to current player wins, including current player.

Forest adjacent to touching clearings without crossing printed path and forests separated by one printed path. Winter river divides forests as paths do; Fall has no special rule. Slip uses this adjacency. Rivers otherwise are not paths.

25 warriors,8 wood supply; keep any corner. One warrior each clearing except diagonally opposite corner. One sawmill/workshop/recruiter among keep and adjacent clearings respecting slots. Other five of each type on tracks right to left, leftmost empty.

20 warrior supply; roost and six warriors in corner not another starting corner, diagonally opposite starting corner if possible. Choose leader, others face up; Viziers in indicated columns. Six remaining roosts track right to left.
10 warriors supply;3 bases on matching board spaces,10 sympathy track. Three hand cards from common setup plus three additional supporters face down. No map pieces/officers.

Choose character, pawn any forest; shuffle quests and display three; relationships Indifferent for each other faction. Take S-marked listed character items, tea/coins/bags face up on matching tracks, others Satchel; unused S items box.
Recommended17/18/21 respectively; Marquise10,Eyrie7,Vagabond5,Alliance3. Adventurous any mix17+.

During Birdsong, place one wood per sawmill in that sawmill's clearing. During Daylight, an optional Overwork action spends a card matching a clearing with a sawmill to place one wood token in that clearing. Production is limited by the finite eight-wood supply; place the maximum available when unable to place all required pieces, and costs are not waived. In Evening, draw one card plus uncovered draw bonuses, then discard chosen hand cards down to five.
Once-per-turn Recruit places one per recruiter as far as supply allows; maximum available, Marquise chooses eligible placements when shortage.
Normally ignore printed VP and score one; extra crafting-point effects still apply. Builder ignores Disdain so printed VP applies.

Builder Recruit/Move ignore Disdain; Charismatic Recruit/Battle must recruit two; Commander Move/Battle extra attacker hit; Despot Move/Build one extra VP when removing at least one enemy building/token in battle.
No. Charismatic requires two; inability fully complete causes immediate turmoil despite maximum-possible piece placement.
Alliance defending takes higher die, attacker lower; both rolled-hit warrior caps still apply.
Supporters spent only for suit, not crafted or treated as hand cards. Alliance may inspect own face-down stack. They do not count against hand limit.
No. All Revolts precede Spread Sympathy; cannot return to Revolt step after spreading.
No: requires at least three warriors of one other player, not combined enemies. Organize costs removal of own warrior, no supporters and no Martial Law surcharge.
Placement and pawn-only movement do not trigger warrior-entry Outrage. Moving allied warriors there does trigger it.

Up to officer count actions in any order/repetition: Move once, Battle once, Recruit one at base, Organize remove warrior from unsympathetic clearing to place sympathy and score. Officers not consumed. After operations draw one plus uncovered bonuses then discard to five.
Pawn remains on map and damages three items; it cannot be removed.

Rolled cap is all undamaged swords in Satchel face up or down. Exhausted undamaged swords count. Defenseless defending if no undamaged swords. Each hit damages one undamaged item; ignore hits after all undamaged items gone.

Face-up tea/coins/bags in Satchel move to empty matching track space when able; each track capacity three. Exhaust track item into Satchel. Damaged items cannot pay actions even if face up; exhaustion requires face-up undamaged item.

Last step Evening: Satchel plus Damaged load, limit six plus two per face-up bag on track. Track items excluded. Permanently remove chosen Satchel/Damaged items until limit; not immediate on acquisition.

Rest returns all damaged items to Satchel face up, but does not refresh undamaged exhausted items. Refresh flips exhausted face up without repairing damage. Repair moves one damaged item to Satchel keeping face.

Exhaust any ready undamaged item, give matching clearing card to player with faction pieces there. May take crafted item if present, but Aid can occur without item. For non-hostile faction meet printed Aid count within same turn per step, each Aid counts once toward one improvement; advance and score new space.

Each Aid to Allied scores two. May force one Allied faction warriors to accompany move to destination clearing subject to movement rules. At start as attacker may treat one ally warriors there as own, cap warriors plus undamaged swords; cannot use against that same faction.

If more hits are taken removing allied warriors than damaging items in same battle, ally becomes Hostile at battle end. Equal counts do not. Overrides ordinary first-warrior hostility trigger for these battle losses.

Cannot satisfy mixed suits because clearing must match every icon. Each icon exhausts hammer, pawn may activate repeatedly ignoring once/turn cap. Crafted item can immediately be taken face up, usable if otherwise eligible.

Thief boot/torch/tea/sword, exhaust torch Steal random hand card from player with faction pieces in clearing. Tinker boot/torch/bag/hammer, exhaust torch Day Labor matching discard card, bird always valid. Ranger boot/torch/crossbow/sword, exhaust torch Hideout repair three retaining faces, immediately end Daylight for Evening.
Remove ruin and slot becomes open. Ordinary placement cannot remove ruin; ruins removable only explicitly, and building needs open slot.
Coalition partners are not enemies so cannot choose partner as battle enemy. Coalition itself does not grant Allied; relationships still separate and hostile partner resets Indifferent.
First warrior makes faction Hostile but gives no Infamy. Second warrior gives one Infamy; building gives one normal plus one Infamy. Three VP total.
Only buildings: one boot. Any hostile warriors: one base plus one extra boot, not one extra per faction. Slip remains free even into hostile warriors.
Taking puts it into hand only; activation separate during Daylight with at least ten VP. Neither procedure requires spending Marquise/faction action allowance.
Faction piece ownership cannot change; starting faction owns its listed faction pieces except items. Items are not faction pieces and are not owned by a faction.

Resolve immediate effect then discard card. Persistent effect card stays in play area granting its effect. Cards there are not hand cards and can only be spent/discarded/otherwise used if explicitly instructed.
Neither can be crafted. Ambush can be played for immediate battle hits/foil; dominance can be activated for altered win condition or spent for suit.
Random starting player and seating; score markers zero; dice near map. Faction setup letter order distinct from random turn order.
The first player to reach 30 victory points wins immediately; do not wait for the action, phase, or turn to end. Simultaneous 30-point ties use 3.1.1.

Choose a clearing containing your warriors and/or pawn, then choose an enemy in that clearing as defender. A building or token alone does not provide the attacking presence. Battle has no rule prerequisite.

The attacker chooses the order if both players have before-roll effects and likewise if both have after-roll effects. The side taking hits chooses the order of effects triggered by its own pieces being removed, as well as its own removal order subject to warriors first. These explicit decision rules take precedence over the generic current-turn-player fallback.
Ignored hits subtract from the total hit count after counting rolled hits and battle effects. They are not a change to the rolled die or to the warrior-based maximum rolled hits.

Take the corresponding item from the item supply on the map and put it in the Crafted Items box on the faction board. Normally score the card's printed victory points; the Eyrie's Disdain for Trade is the already-tested exception, and Builder suppresses it. Resolve the immediate effect and discard the crafting card.

Eyrie activate roosts before resolving the Decree in Daylight; Alliance activate sympathy tokens during Daylight. A crafting piece has its clearing's suit. A three-color question-mark icon can be paid with a crafting piece of any suit.

Mobilize adds one card from the Alliance's hand to its Supporters stack, subject to the stack's capacity rule. During Daylight Alliance may Craft, Mobilize, and Train in any order and number; it need not finish crafting first.

First score the VP printed on the rightmost empty space of the Roosts track. Then draw one card plus one per uncovered draw bonus, and discard chosen hand cards down to five if necessary. Turmoil ends Daylight and proceeds to this normal Evening, including scoring.

Exhaust one face-up undamaged sword to initiate a battle. An exhausted sword cannot pay that action cost, although undamaged exhausted swords still count toward the Vagabond's maximum rolled hits and prevent defenselessness when defending.
Birdsong, then Daylight, then Evening; next clockwise player begins after Evening ends. Continue until a player wins.
Choose one undamaged item and move it to Damaged box, keeping its current face. Cannot select an already-damaged item to absorb another hit. With no undamaged items remaining, ignore remaining hits.

Take up to the number of officers, in any order and repetition. One Recruit operation places one warrior from supply in any one clearing with an Alliance base, not one at every base. Officers stay on board when operations are used.

The Vagabond may take Daylight actions in any order and number, repeating or interleaving action types as desired, provided each action can pay its item costs and meet its other requirements. There is no separate fixed action-count allowance. Ranger Hideout still immediately ends Daylight as specified.
Exhaust one face-up, undamaged crossbow. An already exhausted or damaged crossbow cannot pay the action cost.

grading: Every requested part must be resolved, correct and supported by summary. Correct/partial/incorrect separately; unsupported correct guesses flagged and cannot pass.

interpretation_notes.Q25: Per independent source review 04 and Law 2.1.1.I, the frozen shorthand must include birds means must treat birds as the prompted non-bird suit, not bird-first selection or exceeding the instructed quantity. Q25 answer entry itself is unchanged.
